title: Direct Forcing: Single-Stage Training with Representation-Space Supervision for Few-Step Autoregressive Video Generation
abstract: arXiv:2610.30861v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Few-step autoregressive video generation enables low-latency streaming, yet prevailing training pipelines separate causal adaptation from distribution matching. Recent representation-based text-to-video methods retain this separation by starting with an ODE initialization stage, even when the target distribution is defined directly by reference videos. We introduce \method, the first single-stage framework that uses reference videos both as paired examples of how a history continues and as a target population for self-generated rollouts. Specifically, Direct Forcing is trained with two complementary signals: (1) Causal Continuation Alignment learns paired spatiotemporal correspondence under reference histories; and (2) Rollout Distribution Matching employs maximum mean discrepancy to align the representation distributions of self-generated and reference videos. To coordinate these signals, we introduce Dynamic Gradient Balancin

translated_title: Direct Forcing：面向少步自回归视频生成的表示空间监督单阶段训练
translated_abstract: 少步自回归视频生成能够实现低延迟流式生成，然而主流的训练流程将因果适配与分布匹配分离开来。近期的基于表示的文本到视频方法延续了这种分离，即使目标分布直接由参考视频定义，它们仍从一个ODE初始化阶段开始。我们提出Direct Forcing，这是首个单阶段框架，将参考视频同时用作展示历史如何延续的配对样本，以及用于自生成rollout的目标分布。具体而言，Direct Forcing通过两个互补信号进行训练：(1) 因果延续对齐，在参考历史条件下学习配对的时空对应关系；(2) Rollout分布匹配，采用最大均值差异（MMD）来对齐自生成视频与参考视频的表示分布。为了协调这两个信号，我们引入了动态梯度平衡机制。
tldr: 提出了首个单阶段框架Direct Forcing，通过因果延续对齐与基于MMD的rollout分布匹配两种互补信号在表示空间进行监督，并利用动态梯度平衡协调二者，从而无需分离式训练流程即可实现少步自回归视频生成。
en_tdlr: Direct Forcing, the first single-stage framework for few-step autoregressive video generation, supervises in representation space with two complementary signals—Causal Continuation Alignment and MMD-based Rollout Distribution Matching—coordinated by Dynamic Gradient Balancing, eliminating the need for separate causal adaptation and distribution matching stages.
